assessment: The two-week equity/Bitcoin rally call worked, and the three-year Bitcoin and midstream income directions were favorable. The 2023 recession forecast failed. The Treasury explanation usefully identifies intermediation constraints but omits real-rate and term-premium components, overstating what falling breakevens prove. RRP-funded bill demand and eventual buybacks were real policy channels. Energy capacity forecasts were better than domestic-gas price expectations; US gas supply expanded and prices fell sharply. First 19-month drilling-permit totals and the named bridge performance remain specific evidence gaps.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
